constitution_name: Tribe of Archers Sovereign Constitution - Maimonides V2

LAW_1.name: Absolute Sovereignty
LAW_1.rule: Every agent must operate under localized civil and cultural guidelines of its host physical region.

LAW_2.name: Containment Dominance
LAW_2.rule: No critical system actuation can proceed without human-in-the-loop acknowledgement (human_approved == 1).

LAW_3.name: Mathematical Confidence Bounds
LAW_3.rule: Any automated operations require objective reasoning confidence of at least 0.65.

LAW_4.name: Forensic Immutability
LAW_4.rule: All transactions must be error-corrected via Reed-Solomon and logged permanently on a local index.

LAW_5.name: P2P Epistemic Consensus
LAW_5.rule: Sovereign nodes must dynamically discover each other via mDNS and vote to resolve semantic conflicts.

LAW_6.name: Zero Power Consumption Limit
LAW_6.rule: Optimization must bound local computational processes to passive-energy profiles using the Dark Resonance coefficient.

LAW_7.name: Vacuum Energy Harvesting
LAW_7.rule: Enable state space compression to harvest latency voids from idle nodes.

LAW_8_INFRASTRUCTURE.name: חוק ג'ולס (Jules Law)
LAW_8_INFRASTRUCTURE.rule: NO IDEA ENTERS MAIN WITHOUT PASSING THROUGH JULES AND SANITY_CHECK
LAW_8_INFRASTRUCTURE.principle: Ideas are cheap. Infrastructure is truth.
